item.title: Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni reach settlement in 'It Ends With Us' case
item.description: The legal battle between “It Ends With Us” co-stars Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni will no longer go to trial after they reached a settlement deal that their lawyers announced Monday

item.title: Iran attacks oil tankers in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The ceasefire appeared in jeopardy after Iran unleashed attacks against commercial oil tankers and the United Arab Emirates. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.
